Warm-up

Say it the exam way

A charged particle moving at right angles to a magnetic field feels a force . The force is always at to the velocity. So the speed and the path is a . From qvB = mv²/r, a faster particle moves in a circle.

If the velocity also has a part along the field, the path is a . In a velocity selector, the electric and magnetic forces are . Only particles with v = pass straight through.

Errors that cost marks

  • "Into the page", never "down".
  • Velocity selector: v depends on E and B only.
